title: Los golpes de Estado
goal: Read how the 1964-1976 wave of military coups produced a distinctly institutional kind of authoritarian rule, and O'Donnell's concept of the bureaucratic-authoritarian state.
grammar: Más bien: matizar en vez de simplemente contrastar

items: List which countries fell under military rule between 1964 and 1976.
Explain O'Donnell's concept of the bureaucratic-authoritarian state.
Explain how the National Security Doctrine justified repression.
Describe the common pattern these military governments shared.
Use más bien to refine a claim instead of flatly opposing it.
